result:
I found no blocking defects. All four round-1 blockers are closed and proven against round-1 code, but there are three advisories. One of them must be checked on crm-beta before the real load.

```
VERDICT: FINDINGS
CANDIDATE: 375e1ca890161b0a9d569432e28f1e21905bbd6a
FINDING phone-international-precondition-unenforced advisory: zero writes on a second run depends on the CRM setting phoneNumberInternational=false (EspoCRM default is true). Neither crm-load nor load.sh checks it; it is only documented as an operator precondition, "set by CRM-007" (docs/IMPORT.md:26). CRM-007 is not on this branch. With true, every re-run re-PUTs each +44 phone and repeats the rejected PUT for each national-format phone; national-format phones are dropped from beta with phone_rejected | evidence: scratch r2/t/drive.py against the reference selftest run-1, two runs on one persisted fake: INTL=0 gives run 2 "writes=0"; INTL=1 gives run 2 "writes=62". r2/t/rerun_intl.py (unit fixture org): intl=True gives run 2 writes=6 (3x PUT Account [phoneNumber], 3x PUT Contact [phoneNumberData]) | expected: before the beta load, the operator confirms phoneNumberInternational=false on crm-beta. Better still, a pre-flight refusal or a comparison that ignores formatting. The setting is outside this WO's allowlist, so documenting it was the in-scope option
FINDING refused-phone-retried-every-run advisory: when the server refuses one phone, the retry drops the whole phoneNumberData, so a valid sibling phone is lost too (a phone_rejected exception is recorded per record). Every later run repeats one rejected PUT for that record, so load-report requests.writes is never 0 (no data changes) | evidence: r2/t/phone2.py, Contact C0 Phone="01632 960100 ext 2", MobilePhone="07700 900000", fake with false: stored phoneNumberData=None; run 2 report "writes 1", requests [('PUT','Contact',['phoneNumberData'])], contacts all unchanged | expected: drop only the refused number, and make no write attempt on a re-run with an unchanged snapshot. Operators should read a small non-zero writes count on re-run against the phone_rejected count
FINDING synthetic-users-not-exportable advisory: `crm-load users` on the reference selftest exports 0 users, because the synthetic UserType values are "Value A/B/C", not "Standard". The dev operator stage therefore provisions nobody, so every owner is unresolved and owner assignment is never tried on crm-dev. Real data (UserType=Standard) is not affected | evidence: python3 -I -B cand/load/bin/crm-load.py users <syn-selftest>/run-1 --role-map t/rm.json --out outs/users1 gave "users=0 skipped_user_not_human=6"; the snapshot's UserType values are ['Value A','Value A','Value C','Value B','Value B','Value B'] | expected: the operator knows dev cannot exercise owner assignment with the reference synthetic data
EVIDENCE:
- HEAD: git -C worktree rev-parse HEAD = 375e1ca8...; git status --porcelain empty at start and end (only pre-existing ignored __pycache__ dated 19:50; the worktree is a read-only FS).
- Suites: from the worktree and from a git-archive copy: tests/unit 311 OK; tests/load (python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s tests/load -t .) 112 OK.
- Scope r1 (b683d1a) to HEAD: git diff --stat touches only README.md (usage line), docs/IMPORT.md, load/**, scripts/load.sh, tests/load/**. Nothing else outside the allowlist.
- Real synthetic data: the reference extractor (scratch copy, CONTRACT_VERSION patched 3 to 4 to match its own v4 contract file, as in round 1) `selftest --quick` gives syn-selftest (parent mode selftest, RECONCILED, 56 files; run-1/run-2 mode extract, origin_kind production), sealed 0700/0400.
- Synthetic rule (crm-load in-process, FakeEspo): dev run-1/run-2 rc0. Refused, all with 0 requests: beta run-1 (target_beta_requires_extract); run-1 copied to cp-extract into beta (synthetic_content_in_beta); cp-extract into dev; unsealed parent; parent mode extract; unlisted file in parent; run-3; bare "-selftest"; symlinked parent; z-extract nested in n-selftest into beta; reconcile dir as snapshot (not_a_snapshot). load.sh also refuses beta under *-selftest.
- Non-vacuity (round-1 code + new fixtures): r1 loaded cp-extract into beta (rc0, 178 writes) and refused the real selftest run-1 in dev; the candidate refuses and accepts these respectively. r1 second run against the faithful fake = 55 writes; the candidate = 0 (reference selftest, phoneNumberInternational=false; also run-2 after run-1 then run-2 again = 0). The argv scanner did detect a key-bearing argv (my own server's, first attempt), so the scan can fail.
- Emails: messageId is dummy:<id> on all 15. Mapper probe: blank or whitespace CallType gives no direction + call_direction_unknown; unknown CallType gives enum_unmapped, no direction; Call fallbacks give date_start_from_activity_date / date_start_from_created; Meeting no start gives date_start_from_created; Email (and Task-Email) with no MessageDate/CompletedDateTime gives dateSent None (never created). `from` is the bare address, fromString "Name <addr>". Queue owner gives owner_queue_or_group, missing owner gives owner_unresolved, assignedUser None and sfOwnerId kept. A soft-deleted parent is not linked (parent_soft_deleted_in_sf).
- Beta path: production-shaped p1/p2-extract (Account names de-sentinelled, manifest re-hashed) + reference reconcile in <id>-reconcile/report layout (MIGRATION.md:30). p2 + its reconcile: rc0, Contact absent_unexplained=1, all four relationship totals equal (12/57/31/10). p2 + p1's reconcile: reconciliation_snapshot_mismatch, 0 requests.
- Resume: writes cut at 1/37/120/177 (rc4), then --resume gives rc0; report, exceptions and DB equal the uninterrupted run; a further re-run gives writes=0.
- load.sh e2e (copy with the 4 fixed lines rewritten to scratch/uid; server and load.sh in one sandboxed command): dev run 1 rc0 178 writes, run 2 writes=0. The server saw only 127.0.0.1 clients. /proc/*/cmdline scanned on every request: 0 processes with the key. Key not in stdout/stderr/outputs; output files 0600. Refused: existing outdir, outdir under the snapshot base. Port 18765 free after kill.
- Network: LoopbackHttpTransport refuses localhost/10.0.0.1/127.0.0.2/::1 (host_refused). CRM_LOAD_HOST=localhost gives rc4 and no output dir.
- Content: no SENTINEL in any stdout/stderr/load-report/exceptions/progress/run.json across all runs, and across 150 fuzz iterations of randomised field values (0 leaks, only GET/POST/PUT, never DELETE). Fuzz gave 27 uncaught TypeErrors, all from int/bool in To/CcAddress, which Salesforce never emits; the messages carry no content.
```
